children: SOUTHWIRE: BECAME AWARE OF UNUSUAL ACTIVITY ON ITS SYSTEMS ON JANUARY 29, 2026
SOUTHWIRE: INVESTIGATION DETERMINED THAT UNAUTHORIZED PARTY ACQUIRED CERTAIN FILES ON SOUTHWIRE'S SYSTEMS BETWEEN NOVEMBER 2025 AND JANUARY 2026
SOUTHWIRE: OFFERING 24 MONTHS OF COMPLIMENTARY CREDIT MONITORING, IDENTITY PROTECTION SERVICES TO PEOPLE WHOSE INFORMATION MAY HAVE BEEN IMPACTED
SOUTHWIRE: IN LATE OCT, CO LEARNED INFORMATION VARIED BY INDIVIDUAL, MAY HAVE INCLUDED NAMES, SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBERS, DATE OF BIRTH AMONG OTHERS
